post_call_copy.basis: Bounded decoded operands at the pinned RVAs

allocation_audit.review_basis: Pinned Ghidra function metadata and bounded per-function queries; large fb4a0 uses bounded local decode instead of unsuccessful decompilation
allocation_audit.conclusion: All ten recognized 0x228 allocation returns attach to Frame in the next instruction. No unattached producer window exists at these sites.
limits: Only the pinned allocator at direct call sites with must-known RCX=0x228 is seeded
PE unwind groups, direct CFG edges, affine registers and private spills only; indirect edges and indexed memory are excluded
Frame reloads retain their original load root; this audit complements 421 and does not replace it
A lost must-alias, unrecognized allocator, assembly-only range or undecoded tail may hide other paths
The Ghidra data reference to the enable helper does not resolve indirect callers
Allocation-size coincidence alone is untyped; the ten sites were individually checked against feature ownership
No whole-program producer-absence claim or bit17 numerical formula follows from this audit

conclusion: The DRS enable helper clears existing feature bytes only for nonzero initialize; both generic allocators retain every existing feature byte even with initialize=1. All selected owned bit17 bytes survive Frame save/read.
limits: Owned finite feature values and feature-only zero-dimension allocation requests
Fresh enable with initialize=0 gives no defined payload; its contents were never read before being fully filled
Whole-block clear also removes inner flags, so bit17 is then omitted rather than computed by serialization
A generic request of zero was checked before explicitly enabling the save mask
No authoring assignment, commercial nonzero bit17 producer or arbitrary invalid allocation protocol is proved
